liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (3 reviews): Listener calls this the hottest version of the song they have ever heard; Listener believes this is the best version of the song they have heard [17][21][22]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Drums seem to struggle with the beat at the start, appearing a little sloppy [22]
- **Deal** (1 review): Performance is slower than usual, though not as slow as Morning Dew [22]
- **Me and Bobby McGee** (1 review): Listener describes the performance as a nice version of the song [14]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Listener characterizes the performance as good vintage playing [14]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Listener describes the playing as flowing, creative, and beautiful [18]

## The recordings

- **gd74-06-22.aud.obv.30999.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 27 songs; 184 min; rated 3.78/5 by 9 [1]. Said about its sound: Sound quality is very good, better than many other audience tapes heard; Guitars sound good, though the drums are noted as a little low [15][18]
- **gd1974-06-22.sbd.matrix-sb21a.chappell.83488.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 182 min; rated 4.86/5 by 7 [3]
- **gd74-06-22.mtx.seamons.106156.flac24**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 184 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [5]
- **gd74-06-22.moore.weiner.gdADT13.14193.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 183 min; rated 4.7/5 by 10 [6]. Said about its sound: Audio quality is superior to the listener's previous cassette copy of this performance [13]
- **gd74-06-22.sbd.sacks.212.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 158 min; rated 3.86/5 by 7 [11]. Said about its sound: Sound quality is quite good despite numerous performance miscues and blown lyrics; Recording still sounds good despite having more material to compare it against [14][16]

## Around the show

- Jai-Alai Fronton acoustics amplify crowd voices, making the venue feel small [21]
- Miami Jai-Alai Fronton had great acoustics, hooking the attendee on the band forever [23]
- Listener considers this the best show from 1974 [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd74-06-22.aud.obv.30999.shnf**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Mark Cohen, Noah Weiner and The Wizard; source: Audience: AKG D-1000E's (remastered by Wizard) [1]. Also: Recorded by Jerry Moore with two handheld AKG D-1000E mics into a Sony 152; Analog transfer to DAT by Mark Cohen in December 2002, then to SHN by Noah Weiner [1]
- **gd1974-06-22.sbd.matrix-sb21a.chappell.83488.flac16**: transferred by Chris Chappell; source: Sick Bits Vol. 21a - SBD/AUD Matrix of 2 previously circulating sources: SBD (shnid=212) + AUD (shnid=14193). [3]. Also: Sources converted to WAV via Sony Vegas 5, then to FLAC 16 level 8 [3]
- **gd74-06-22.mtx.seamons.106156.flac24**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: SBD (shnid 90200) + AUD (SHNID 105825) [5]. Also: Audience recording by Jerry Moore was transferred by Rob Berger [5]
- **gd74-06-22.moore.weiner.gdADT13.14193.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Mark Cohen and Noah Weiner; source: Audience: AKG D-1000E's [6]
- **gd74-06-22.sbd.sacks.212.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [11]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by RareVinyl.com: [Grateful Dead Dave's Picks Volume 34: Jai-Alai Fronton, Miami, Fl 6/23/74 + Dave's Picks 2020 Bonus Disc 2020 US 3-CD se](https://uk.rarevinyl.com/products/grateful-dead-dave-s-picks-volume-34-jai-alai-fronton-miami-fl-6-23-74-plus-dave-s-picks-2020-bonus-disc-us-3-cd-album-triple-set-r2607314-790468) [25]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Jai-Alai Fronton - June 23, 1974](https://www.dead.net/show/june-23-1974) [26]
